# Tattoo Generator

Tattoo generator: your idea turned into clean tattoo flash art in fine line, traditional, blackwork, Japanese or geometric style, generated as designs to take to your artist.

## What it does
Describe the motif, pick a style and where it goes. Claude tells you the price and creates the designs.

**How the files are made:** each tattoo design is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Design references for your tattoo artist, not stencils.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install tattoo-generator@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Tattoo Generator talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/tattoo/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each tattoo design uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The tattoo designs show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_tattoo_models` | Models for tattoo designs with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_tattoo_cost` | Exact price of one tattoo design before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_tattoo` | Starts one tattoo design in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_tattoo` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A fine line wolf under a crescent moon for the forearm"
- "A Japanese koi fish, traditional style"
- "A minimalist lotus with the name Mia"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the tattoo design (the idea, the style and the placement) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
- Documentation: https://megascenes.com/connectors#claude
- Support: https://megascenes.com/support
